name: Yaoyao
quote: Hello, I'm Yaoyao, a lowly disciple of the adeptus, Streetward Rambler. It's a pleasure to make your acquaintance! If you encounter any difficulties outdoors... then lemme help you!
description: A young disciple of the adeptus Streetward Rambler in Liyue, known for her kindness, cooking skill, and eagerness to help travelers in need.
